claim_summary: EpiWorld contributes a policy-conditioned epidemic world model and a protocol-guided LLM decision workflow whose counterfactual rollout feedback is distilled into reusable, regime-specific lessons.

claim_evidence.quote: We present EpiWorld, a closed-loop framework that grounds an LLM policy actor in a learned actionconditioned epidemiological world model and a tiered skill library of public-health protocols, surveillance tools, and adaptive lessons accumulated through after-action analysis.

modules.name: Action-conditioned epidemic world-model rollouts
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the model predicts epidemic trajectories conditioned on interventions and evaluates policy futures against hospital burden; changing to a non-policy forecasting task would require a different action-conditioned state and decision objective. It is temporal processing because it encodes observation windows and forecasts their evolution.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - action-conditioned epidemic policy rollouts and hospital-burden objective

evidence.quote: EpiWorld addresses the epidemic policy optimisation problem in Eq. 2 through two coupled components: (i) an epidemiological world model that approximates the unknown policy-conditioned dynamics and enables counterfactual rollout, and (ii) a protocol-guided policy actor that generates interventions from predicted epidemic trajectories.

modules.name: Protocol-constraint gates
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the predicates define admissible public-health interventions and their validation criteria; changing task family changes the action envelope and policy constraints. Temporal consistency checks such as the minimum step-down interval instantiate validation.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - intervention admissibility and policy validation are task-specific

evidence.quote: Protocol Constraints (T1 ). Protocol Constraints are deterministic procedures codified by international and national public-health authorities: pandemic-interval classification, ACIP vaccineallocation ordering, NPI proportionality validation, and IHR notification thresholds. Each skill κ ∈ T1 returns a constraint predicate cκ (a, Xt , g) ∈ {0, 1}.

modules.name: Epidemic surveillance estimators
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the estimators supply epidemic-specific evidence (transmission, severity, stringency, vulnerability) for intervention selection; another task family would require different estimators and decision semantics. Their calculations operate on ordered epidemic observations, so processing is embedded.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - epidemic estimators support intervention decisions

evidence.quote: Surveillance Skills (T2 ). Surveillance Skills are analytical tools epidemiologists use: Rt estimators (Cori et al., 2013) quantify transmission acceleration, severity ratios (CFR, IFR) project hospital load, the OxCGRT stringency index (Hale et al., 2021) aggregates NPI levels into a scalar, and the ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index flags vulnerable populations.

modules.name: After-action lesson evolution and retrieval
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because each lesson changes a surveillance parameter used to select epidemic interventions, and the source targets policy-relevant failures and hospital outcomes; another task requires redesigned lesson targets and objectives. The bank retains and retrieves prior rollout evidence as temporal context.
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - lesson updates are bound to epidemic policy parameters and outcomes

evidence.quote: The protocol-guided actor improves through an after-action adaptation cycle that updates the Adaptive-Lesson bank from simulated epidemic rollouts, leaving Protocol Constraints and Surveillance Skill structures untouched and inference cost unchanged.

temporal_validity.quote: The world model is trained on Dec 2020 – Sep 2021 (Alpha and Delta waves) and evaluated on the heldout Jan 2022 Omicron wave plus eight subsequent weeks, giving a temporal-OOD setting.

task_performance.quote: Table 1 shows world-model performance. EpiWorld outperforms all baselines on OOD PeakMAE across the three datasets, with gains of ∼ 6%, ∼ 4%, and ∼ 8% on COVID-19 SEIR, Influenza SEIR, and Real US (Omicron) respectively

decision_utility.quote: Table 2: Policy optimisation performance over 8-week rollouts, reported as cumulative hospitalisation reduction against the reference historical policy (lower is better).
